app.title: Gebeta
app.tagline: The Ethiopian game of stones and holes

picker.quickHint: One round. Whoever takes more stones wins.
picker.matchHint: Up to 5 rounds, played for homes (ቤት).

summary.title: End of round {{n}}
summary.draw: A drawn round. Both start again with six homes.

hint.sow: Tap one of your <1>glowing holes</1> to pick up its stones and sow them.
hint.relay: Try the <1>pulsing hole</1>: its last stone lands on other stones, so you carry on.
hint.stop-empty: Try the <1>pulsing hole</1>: its sowing ends in an empty hole.
hint.capture-last: Try the <1>pulsing hole</1>: its last stone makes four, a ቤት for you.
hint.capture-owner: Try the <1>pulsing hole</1>: a stone on the way makes four for that hole’s owner.
hint.round-end: Keep playing until one side <1>runs out of stones</1>.
hint.any: <1>Any glowing hole</1> will do. Watch what the stones do.

sow.title: Sowing
sow.body: Pick up every stone in one of your holes and drop them one by one into the holes that follow, going round the board.

relay.title: Carrying on
relay.body: If your last stone lands in a hole that already has stones, pick them all up and keep sowing.

stop-empty.title: Stopping
stop-empty.body: When your last stone lands in an empty hole, your turn ends.

capture-last.title: Taking a ቤት (home)
capture-last.body: If your last stone makes exactly four, you take those four, wherever the hole is. Four stones are a ቤት. Your turn ends.

capture-owner.title: The owner’s four
capture-owner.body: If a stone in the middle of a sowing makes exactly four, the four go to whoever owns that hole, even when it is not their turn.

round-end.title: The end of the round
round-end.body: When a player has no stones left in their holes, the round ends and the other player takes every stone still on the board.

homes.title: Playing for homes (ቤት)
homes.body: In a full match, every four stones you take is a home for the next round. If this were a full match, you would own {{you}} homes next round and the computer {{them}}.

about.title: About Gebeta · ገበጣ
about.p1: Gebeta is played across Ethiopia. In the 12-hole version there are two rows of six holes, one row for each player.
about.p2: Children scoop the holes into the earth and play with small pebbles, four in every hole to start.
about.p3: You sow the stones around the board one by one. Stones are taken in fours, and four stones together are called a ቤት (bet, “home”).

noWebgl.title: Can’t show the 3D board
noWebgl.body: Gebeta needs WebGL 2, which this browser doesn’t offer. Try an up-to-date Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.

turn.title: Turn your phone
turn.body: Gebeta is played sideways, the way the board lies in front of you.
